title: A proper surjective quasi-projective scheme cover of a separated finite-type algebraic space

standard_prerequisites.use: Algebraic spaces and etale presentations, bounded fibre cardinality and stratification, scheme-theoretic images, projective compactification of affine schemes, equality of maps from schematically dense opens, and the refined valuative criterion.

core_obligations: Construct the compactified configuration space of a maximal number of distinct etale preimages and glue the maps from its coordinate-open loci toX.
Prove properness by valuation lifting and then finish surjectivity by induction on the maximal fibre size over the remaining closed complement.

proof_roadmap.step: Construct the compactified configuration space of a maximal number of distinct etale preimages and glue the maps from its coordinate-open loci toX.
Prove properness by valuation lifting and then finish surjectivity by induction on the maximal fibre size over the remaining closed complement.

difficulty_reason: The scheme cover is built from a configuration of distinct etale lifts, and the same configuration controls both valuation extension and the strict decrease in the fibre-size induction. This is a specific H2 construction, not a restatement of the scheme Chow lemma.

compared.difference: This migrates the existing unpublished research record, not an additional count beside it.

editorial_notes: Public016 is Chow for separated finite-type schemes over a Noetherian base; public492 is a derived local modification of a finitely presented scheme. Here the source may be an algebraic space and the base ring is arbitrary; the constructed cover is an actual scheme.
The older two substantive reviews support the complete109-line author proof; they are reused without repeating a full proof audit.
